mintAuthority.summary: M minting is routed through the immutable Ethereum MinterGateway under validator/collateral checks and raiseable M0 TTG parameters. Solana M is a portal-minted spoke whose 1-of-2 program-derived mint multisig is route-limited, while one EOA can upgrade the portal program and replace those constraints.

controls.label: M0 MinterGateway
controls.capDescription: MToken.mint is callable only by the MinterGateway; MinterGateway issuance depends on TTG-approved minters, validator attestations, mint-delay review, and collateral/debt checks.

routeChecks.attestorQuorum: M0 docs describe validator attestations before minting; this review did not enumerate the live validator threshold.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: MinterGateway minting is bounded by approved-Minter status, collateral/debt checks, and mint-delay review before MToken mint.
routeChecks.caps: Per-Minter capacity can be changed by M0 TTG governance, so the cap is protocol-governed rather than immutable.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: MinterGateway is confirmed immutable/non-proxy; cap governance remains with M0 TTG and Registrar governance.

controls.evidence: Re-verified at Ethereum block 25712124: MToken.minterGateway() returned this immutable MinterGateway and ttgRegistrar() returned 0x119fbeedd4f4f4298fb59b720d5654442b81ae2c. The gateway enforces approved-minter, validator-attestation, delay, and collateral-ratio constraints but does not itself govern their values, so canRaiseCap is false for this contract. TTG governance is modeled separately as the cap raiser.

controls.label: M0 TTG Registrar governance
controls.capDescription: M0 Two Token Governance controls Registrar configuration used by MinterGateway, including approved minter/validator parameters, collateral update intervals, mint delay, and mint ratio.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712124, MinterGateway.ttgRegistrar() returned this Registrar. M0's primary governance and role specifications assign approved-minter, validator, and issuance-parameter changes to Two Token Governance. This control can authorize new issuance participants and raise replaceable mint constraints but cannot bypass MinterGateway's transaction checks directly.

controls.label: M Solana SPL mint authority
controls.capDescription: Solana M is a spoke deployment bridged from Ethereum M through the M0 portal/transceiver design; base supply remains governed by the Ethereum MinterGateway. The SPL Token-2022 mintAuthority is a 1-of-2 SPL multisig (ms2SCrTYioPuumF6oBvReXoVRizEW5qYkiVuUEak7Th) whose two signers are off-curve PDAs controlled by M0 Portal and allied programs; all programs share upgrade authority 9QpF8a9TDM9DMiQ556bjEAyAx3WRunzW9HfiDcAPNyJW.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: Solana M is a spoke deployment bridged from Ethereum M; base supply remains governed by the Ethereum MinterGateway.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The SPL mint authority is a 1-of-2 SPL multisig whose signers are off-curve PDAs controlled by M0 portal/allied programs.
routeChecks.caps: Effective Solana mint capacity is bounded by the portal route and base M supply, not by an immutable Solana token cap.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: M0 Solana programs share upgrade authority 9QpF8a9TDM9DMiQ556bjEAyAx3WRunzW9HfiDcAPNyJW; extension authorities point to the same EOA where checked.

controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 438047792, the M Token-2022 mint still reported this 1-of-2 SPL multisig as mintAuthority and a null freeze authority. Its signers are program-derived authorities in the portal route, so this multisig is cap-limited by current bridge execution and cannot itself raise that route limit; the shared program upgrade authority is modeled separately.

controls.label: M0 Solana program upgrade authority
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 438047853, the Portal program still resolved to programData GBcoKgAkTQ5ZYJM2PzsjhRnDfkwBcgx7hapcAJjrcu5n, whose upgradeable-loader state named this EOA as upgrade authority. It can replace the portal logic and thereby change or bypass current Solana route constraints, so canRaiseCap is true.

sources.label: M0 Research — approved collateral structures for Minters (2024-11-20)

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712124, MToken.minterGateway() still resolved to the immutable MinterGateway and ttgRegistrar() returned 0x119fbeedd4f4f4298fb59b720d5654442b81ae2c. Existing pinned reads establish mint ratio 9950, mint delay 300 seconds, validator threshold 1, and a 108000-second collateral update interval; expired collateral counts as zero. M0's primary specifications assign replaceable issuance parameters and approved minter/validator sets to TTG governance, so the gateway is cap-limited while aggregate cap semantics remain raiseable. At finalized Solana slots 438047792 and 438047853, the mint authority remained a 1-of-2 portal-derived multisig with null freeze authority, and the portal ProgramData retained EOA upgrade authority 9QpF8a9TDM9DMiQ556bjEAyAx3WRunzW9HfiDcAPNyJW. Validator attestations support periodic reconciliation; no unified prudential supervisor or public mint-authority incident was identified in the reviewed primary sources.
